messages:
toni-cs: Heads up — AcmeProd (dedicated pool acme-dedicated-us) reported a big morning ramp and saw ~25-35% 429s for ~6 minutes. Customer says autoscaler didn't add capacity quickly enough and some requests hit auth/billing 429s downstream.

sara-support: Sorry to hear that. Do we have probe/logs + customer repro? Which model and tier?

toni-cs: Model: small-llama-v1 (quantized), tier: dedicated-reserve. Repro: hitting a 300rps spike from their loadtest at 08:12 PST. They captured request IDs: req_8765, req_8766, req_8767.

jamie-eng-platform: Assigning myself to triage. Quick checklist: 1) autoscaler events 2) node/pod imagepull/backoff 3) warm-pool depletion 4) attach/registry quotas.

ryan-eng-runtime: I saw a similar pattern yesterday where imagepull backoffs + cold pool being 0 led to slow scale-up (pulls + attach latency add ~30-90s). Can you grab controller logs around 08:12?

toni-cs: Pasting timeline from customer and our logs:
```
08:11:55 spike start
08:12:05 router 429 spike begins
08:12:14 autoscaler: target_needed=12 -> scale request issued
08:12:15 k8s: Pod scheduling pending (image pull)
08:12:18 imagepull backoff for 3/12 pods: ErrImagePull
08:12:30 registry rate-limit: 429 from registry-service
08:12:45 attach-controller: attaching volume timeout after 18s, retry
08:13:20 first new worker becomes Ready
08:14:00 full capacity reached but some requests still 429
```

sara-support: Interesting — registry returned 429s during the spike which cascaded. Is our private registry throttled by regional burst limits?

jamie-eng-platform: That registry 429 is new in these repros. If image pulls are delayed by registry throttle, autoscaler will still request pods but they stay Pending. Suggest short-term mitigation: increase minReplicas for acme-dedicated-us to 4 (they were at 1), enable imagePullPrewarm to reduce coldpulls, and temporarily bump attach-concurrency.

ryan-eng-runtime: Config notes: the autoscaler has a 20s probe cooldown + 30s node readiness delay. Image download + attach can add ~40-70s. Combined that's why they saw >1m lag. Also saw a spurious error in attach-controller logs: "rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = billing account not active" — might be a billing blocker for some host attachments (rare).

toni-cs: Customer says their billing account was fine. Could the "PermissionDenied" be a downstream infra transient?

jamie-eng-platform: Possibly a degraded IAM token from our agent when the spike hit. Ops action: check the attach-service audit logs and token refresh errors between 08:11-08:14.

sara-support: For immediate customer relief I can: 1) raise minReplicas to 4 and 2) kick off a one-off image prewarm job to populate nodes. Should I proceed? (will need approval for temporary resource bump)

toni-cs: Customer agreed to a temporary bump. Please proceed.

jamie-eng-platform: I'll run the change and monitor. Also scheduling a follow-up to investigate registry throttling with infra. Putting a canary increase through now.

deploy-bot: rollout/start acme-dedicated-minreplica-bump by jamie-eng-platform @ 2026-03-17T15:22:10Z

jamie-eng-platform: Change applied — minReplicas=4, prewarm job queued. Watching autoscaler metrics: request for +11 pods -> pods launching; image pulls in progress.

ryan-eng-runtime: Quick diagnostic command for the team: 
```
kubectl -n dedicated get pods -l app=acme-worker -o wide
kubectl -n dedicated logs deploy/autoscaler --since=15m | tail -n 100
```

toni-cs: Customer reports error rate dropped to <2% after bump, latency back to normal. They asked what caused the cascade so they can avoid it.

jamie-eng-platform: Postmortem points: (a) registry rate-limiting during large simultaneous pulls, (b) attach-service transient permission error causing some attach retries, (c) low minReplicas + cooldowns made the platform sensitive to cold-pool depletion. Action items: 1) work with infra to add registry backoff jitter and prewarm hooks, 2) add better autoscaler telemetry (time in Pending due to imagepull vs attach), 3) docs: recommend minReplicas>=2 for high-ramp customers.

ryan-eng-runtime: I'll own (2) — add a metric for "pod_wait_reason" with buckets imagepull/attach/sched so we can alert when imagepull is the dominant cause.

sara-support: I'll send customer summary and timeframe. Thanks team.

toni-cs: Marking as resolved for now; keeping ticket open until infra finishes registry investigation. :white_check_mark:
